payload.description: Control your Hue lights, Sonos and Spotify music, and see your Nest cameras, from Leaf and through your Agents. Smart Home links Leaf to the devices and services in your home: Philips Hue lights, Sonos speakers, Spotify and Google Nest cameras. Every part is optional, so connect only what you own. It is not a security system and it does not replace the Hue, Sonos, Spotify or Google Home apps. It lets you and your Agents use those from Leaf.
